title: server on a cloud VM
summary: Same shape as a NUC. What differs: the env profile it is driven with, and that the key usually has to be materialised out of a credentials bundle first. Planet name without a generation suffix (terra).

fields.comment: address the dev machine connects to
the server checkout ON the VM: delivery target and Gradle cwd
private key path; omit to use the ssh default
what to extract when the key path does not exist -- the tooling never falls back to another key

fields.example: <cloud region / resource group> / <filesystem root on the VM>
fields.comment: location question 1 -- where this instance lives (host + filesystem)
location question 2 -- where its build process lives
location question 3 -- which source repositories the build pulls apps from

fields.example: <registry-url or 'local docker daemon on the VM'>
fields.comment: location question 4 -- where the container images live
base URL of a running OntoGate viewer for this project's Spine; leave unset if none runs
live | planned -- 'planned' means agreed but not built yet
